body: Partly built: the authtest package (round 2, in the core module) gives an SQLite-in-memory harness, captured mail and SMS, a clock and signed-in requests, but it is aimed at apps, not plugin authors. Missing: the fault-injecting driver. sweepFaults still lives only in the integration test package, so docs and examples/plugin-delivery copy the pattern. Audit 2026-10-05.
